scores.tell: Red-to-orange background with peach floor is slightly warm-heavy, but the green and yellow chair reads like the real cards.
Purple background with a green ground is believable. The cream body is a bit desaturated, and the green grass is a little dull.
Grey-purple stone floor and a near-black cauldron make the palette murky. Real cards keep bright, clean color. Pink stripes and lime goo are loud and unrelated.
Fully saturated pink, blue and purple jellyfish on a deep blue ray background. It has a glowing, airbrushed look and little neutral rest, but the palette is clean.
Primary-color ball on orange sand with an orange background. It is warm-biased, but the hues are clean and match the real cards.
Muted mauve-brown rock on cyan waves. The dull purplish brown is less saturated than real heroes, though the orange flames add a good accent.
Rich, varied palette of aqua, thatch gold and fruit colors. It matches the real cards' loud-but-organized color, with only a slight overload of hue families.
Yellow-orange device on a purple ring background. The complementary pairing is clean and shadows stay in related hues, so there is no clear tell.
Real-looking: blue sea and sky against warm wood, with a red-and-white ring buoy as the accent. Shadows are rich.
Fruit colors are vivid and the glass is a pale teal. The warm peach background is slightly washed out, but the palette is believable.
